The '''''Nikto Kajidic''''', roughly meaning "Nikto prosper by this", was an [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] that saw service during the time of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
When the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Ga'p'tashi]] agreed to become a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] for the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]], they assisted him in acquiring an Imperial Customs Frigate, which he named the ''Nikto Kajidic''. After assembling a crew and disrupting a number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations, Ga'p'tashi took the ship to the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]], where he began using it to attack the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodrans]].

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Kajidic'' was commanded by Ga'p'tashi and its crew was made up of Niktos and [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]].
